tools.name: cortex_analyze_architecture
tools.description: Analyze knowledge and code graph architecture, detecting communities, god nodes (centrality score), import cycles, and modular cohesion.

tools.name: cortex_capture_passive
tools.description:
Extract and save structured learnings from text output. Use this at the end of a task to capture knowledge automatically.

The tool looks for sections like "## Key Learnings:" or "## Aprendizajes Clave:" and extracts numbered or bulleted items. Each item is saved as a separate observation.

Duplicates are automatically detected and skipped  -- safe to call multiple times with the same content.

content.description: The text output containing a '## Key Learnings:' section with numbered or bulleted items

tools.name: cortex_code_find
tools.description: Searches indexed code symbols with substring, regex, kind filter, and relevance ranking across 13 languages.

is_regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression (default: false)

kind.description: Filter by symbol kind (func, method, struct, class, interface, etc.)

query.description: Query substring or regular expression to search

tools.name: cortex_code_map

tools.name: cortex_code_tests
tools.description: Analyzes the code graph in reverse to locate all test files and test functions that exercise a target symbol, file, or git diff, returning recommended minimal test execution commands for Fast-TDD.

hops.description: Maximum hops in the reverse call graph (default: 3)

target.description: Target symbol name, symbol ID, or relative file path

tools.name: cortex_consolidate
tools.description: Find observations that share the same topic_key and could be consolidated. Returns candidates grouped by topic key. Use cortex_save with the same topic_key to create a merged observation, then cortex_relate with 'supersedes' to link old ones.

project.description: Project to search for consolidation candidates

topic_key.description: Specific topic key to consolidate. If empty, returns all groups with 2+ observations.

tools.description: Get recent memory context from previous sessions. Shows recent sessions and observations to understand what was done before.

project.description: Filter by project (omit for all projects)

scope.description: Filter observations by scope: project (default) or personal

tools.name: cortex_detect_cycles
tools.description: Detect circular dependencies and import/call cycles across code entities in the knowledge graph.

tools.description: Extracts an optimized prompt-injection context pack containing active project rules, architectural decisions, gotchas/bugfix lessons, and core architectural hubs.

include_repo_map.description: Whether to include a token-budgeted repo map (default: false)

repo_map_budget.description: Maximum token budget for repo map if included (default: 1024)

tools.name: cortex_get_blast_radius
tools.description: Calculate the blast radius (impacted downstream code entities, callers, and related observations) when modifying a code symbol, file, or observation.

observation_id.description: Legacy argument: Observation ID or symbol reference to analyze

target.description: Code symbol name (e.g. CalculateTax), file path (e.g. main.go), or node ID

tools.description: Get the full structural code graph with symbols and caller/callee relations for a project.

tools.description: Query indexed code symbols (functions, structs, interfaces, classes, tables) from the dedicated code_symbols table.

kind.description: Filter by symbol kind (func, struct, interface, class, module, table)

query.description: Search pattern for symbol name or signature

tools.name: cortex_get_observation
tools.description: Get the full content of a specific observation by ID. Use when you need the complete, untruncated content of an observation found via cortex_search or cortex_timeline.

tools.name: cortex_get_rules
tools.description: Retrieve active project and global directives, coding guidelines, and behavioral rules.

tools.name: cortex_get_status

tools.name: cortex_graph
tools.description: Traverse the knowledge graph starting from an observation. Returns related observations up to the specified depth, ordered by minimum hop then observation ID. Bounded by max_visited (default 1000, cap 10000, counts the root plus unique visited nodes) and max_results (default 100, cap 1000, counts emitted non-root rows); when eligible data is omitted the output reports truncated=true with the reason(s).

max_visited.description: Global visited budget 1-10000 (default: 1000): the root plus unique visited nodes

tools.name: cortex_graph_path
tools.description: Find the lexicographically smallest shortest observation path between two nodes using bounded breadth-first traversal. On success the payload is the []int64 path (empty array when no path exists within the depth). If the max_visited budget (default 1000, cap 10000, counts the root plus unique visited nodes including the destination) is exhausted before the path can be proved or disproved, a stable traversal-truncated error is returned instead of a false no-path result.

max_visited.description: Global visited budget 1-10000 (default: 1000): the root plus unique visited nodes

tools.name: cortex_graph_relationships
tools.description: List incoming and outgoing relationships for an observation, including type, weight, confidence, provenance, and temporal metadata.

tools.name: cortex_handoff
tools.description:
Record a durable, idempotent handoff: persist an observation (and an optional relation) exactly once per idempotency key.

Replaying the identical payload under the same key returns the SAME observation with status "replayed"; the same key with a DIFFERENT payload is a conflict and mutates nothing. Any failure rolls back every effect — observation, relation, and receipt — atomically.

observation.session_id is required and must reference an existing local session; it is validated before any mutation.

The local namespace returns observation_ref.local_id only.

idempotency_key.description: Stable idempotency key; identical key+payload replays, differing payload conflicts

session_id.description: Session the observation belongs to; the local runtime requires a preexisting session and validates it before any mutation

capability_tuple.description: Opaque JSON evidence forwarded with the handoff; stored as data, never interpreted

path.description: Relative or absolute root path to scan (defaults to '.' or project root)

relation_type.description: Relationship type: references, relates_to, follows, supersedes, contradicts

project.description: Optional project filter (defaults to all or current workspace)

query.description: The question, topic or search query to resolve

tools.name: cortex_revision_history

limit.description: Maximum number of revision snapshots to return (default: 20)

tools.name: cortex_save
tools.description:
Save an important observation to persistent memory. Call this PROACTIVELY after completing significant work  -- don't wait to be asked.

WHEN to save (call this after each of these):
- Architectural decisions or tradeoffs
- Bug fixes (what was wrong, why, how you fixed it)
- New patterns or conventions established
- Configuration changes or environment setup
- Important discoveries or gotchas
- File structure changes

FORMAT for content  -- use this structured format:
  **What**: [concise description of what was done]
  **Why**: [the reasoning, user request, or problem that drove it]
  **Where**: [files/paths affected, e.g. src/auth/middleware.ts, internal/store/store.go]
  **Learned**: [any gotchas, edge cases, or decisions made  -- omit if none]

TITLE should be short and searchable, like: "JWT auth middleware", "FTS5 query sanitization", "Fixed N+1 in user list"

confidence.description: Confidence score 0.0-1.0 (default: 1.0). Lower values indicate less certainty.

scope.description: Scope for this observation: project (default) or personal

session_id.description: Session ID to associate with (default: manual-save-{project})

source.description: Origin of this observation: manual (default), ai, auto, import

title.description: Short, searchable title (e.g. 'JWT auth middleware', 'Fixed N+1 query')

topic_key.description: Optional topic identifier for upserts (e.g. architecture/auth-model). Reuses and updates the latest observation in same project+scope.

type.description: Category: decision, architecture, bugfix, pattern, config, discovery, learning (default: manual)

tools.name: cortex_save_prompt
tools.description: Save a user prompt to persistent memory. Use this to record what the user asked  -- their intent, questions, and requests  -- so future sessions have context about the user's goals.

session_id.description: Session ID to associate with (default: manual-save-{project})

tools.name: cortex_save_rule
tools.description: Create or update a persistent project or global directive/rule in Cortex.

content.description: Detailed description or markdown specification of the rule/directive

title.description: Short summary of the rule (e.g. 'Always use Go 1.26 without CGO')

tools.name: cortex_score
tools.description: Get or recalculate the importance score for an observation. Score formula: base + accessBonus + recencyBonus + edgeBonus + typeBonus - agePenalty, clamped to [0.0, 5.0].

graph_expand.description: Include graph-connected observations in results (default: false)

query.description: Search query  -- natural language or keywords

scope.description: Filter by scope: project (default) or personal

type.description: Filter by type: tool_use, file_change, command, file_read, search, manual, decision, architecture, bugfix, pattern

tools.name: cortex_search_hybrid
tools.description: Search using FTS5 full-text search. When vector search is enabled, combines FTS5 and vector results using Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Falls back to FTS5-only when vectors are disabled.

mode.description: Adaptive retrieval mode: 'auto' (Adaptive-RAG with HippoRAG and CRAG gating), 'direct' (fast factual), 'semantic' (hybrid vectors), 'multi_hop' (HippoRAG graph reasoning)

query.description: Search query -- natural language or keywords

scope.description: Filter by scope: project or personal

tools.name: cortex_session_start

tools.name: cortex_session_summary
tools.description:
Save a comprehensive end-of-session summary. Call this when a session is ending or when significant work is complete. This creates a structured summary that future sessions will use to understand what happened.

FORMAT  -- use this exact structure in the content field:

## Goal
[One sentence: what were we building/working on in this session]

## Instructions
[User preferences, constraints, or context discovered during this session. Things a future agent needs to know about HOW the user wants things done. Skip if nothing notable.]

## Discoveries
- [Technical finding, gotcha, or learning 1]
- [Technical finding 2]
- [Important API behavior, config quirk, etc.]

## Accomplished
- Completed task 1  -- with key implementation details
- Completed task 2  -- mention files changed
- Identified but not yet done  -- for next session

## Relevant Files
- path/to/file.ts  -- [what it does or what changed]
- path/to/other.go  -- [role in the architecture]

GUIDELINES:
- Be CONCISE but don't lose important details (file paths, error messages, decisions)
- Focus on WHAT and WHY, not HOW (the code itself is in the repo)
- Include things that would save a future agent time
- The Discoveries section is the most valuable  -- capture gotchas and non-obvious learnings
- Relevant Files should only include files that were significantly changed or are important for context

content.description: Full session summary using the Goal/Instructions/Discoveries/Accomplished/Files format

tools.name: cortex_suggest_topic_key
tools.description: Suggest a stable topic_key for memory upserts. Use this before cortex_save when you want evolving topics (like architecture decisions) to update a single observation over time.

content.description: Observation content used as fallback if title is empty

title.description: Observation title (preferred input for stable keys)

type.description: Observation type/category, e.g. architecture, decision, bugfix

tools.name: cortex_update
tools.description: Update an existing observation by ID. Only provided fields are changed.
